letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow you bring to my heart, and each monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. I’m still amazed at how you turn ordinary moments into unforgettable adventures—whether we’re sipping karak tea together or strolling by the Creek hand‑in‑hand. You’re my forever cutie, the smile that steadies me, the love that makes every mile between our homes feel like a sweet, shared heartbeat. I love you more with each passing day.
poem:
In desert sands or river’s song,  
Your love is where my soul belongs.  
Across the miles, my heart’s in flight,  
With you, my world is pure delight.
